response.rationale: The order is still in transit and has not been delivered (days_since_delivery is null), so the return window has not yet begun. The standard window rule RET-007 requires days_since_delivery <= 30, which cannot be satisfied because delivery hasn't occurred; likewise RET-008 does not apply. No defective, final-sale, goodwill, or fraud conditions are triggered. Since no rule affirmatively establishes eligibility on the current facts, the item cannot yet be returned.
